name: Inkbox
description:
Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS, and iMessage. Connect Inkbox and the assistant can search and read your mail, draft and send replies, keep threads organized, send and receive text and iMessage conversations, review call history and transcripts, and maintain a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations.

Everything runs against a single identity you choose when you connect, and every action is scoped to that identity's own data. The assistant acts only when you ask it to: Inkbox does not watch your inbox in the background, wake the model, or send anything on its own.

Note: Voice is not part of this connector. It cannot place, answer, or end calls, and it generates no audio or synthetic speech. Calls are read-only here; the assistant can review the history and text transcripts of calls that already took place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inkbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inkbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://inkbox.ai/mcp/anthropic. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inkbox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inkbox lists 59 MCP tools, including inkbox_call_get, inkbox_call_transcript_list, inkbox_calls_list, inkbox_channel_status_get, inkbox_contact_create, inkbox_contact_delete, inkbox_contact_get, inkbox_contact_lookup, inkbox_contact_rules_list, inkbox_contact_update, inkbox_contacts_list, and inkbox_contacts_vcard_export.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inkbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inkbox in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Inkbox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Inkbox is developed by Inkbox. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
